content.expected_result: A repeated or stale relative delta is refused before changing current content.
preconditions: Use a diagram-sourced slide with a current authoring snapshot; publish one relative move and retain the prior digest. Complete story replacements do not accept Saga parent IDs.

steps.action: Repeat the move against the original digest.
steps.expected_result: The command returns expected_snapshot mismatch and the already published current content is unchanged.

steps.action: Submit another relative move with the old digest; reread the current snapshot before retrying.
steps.expected_result: The stale request is rejected before the delta applies. The author must use the current content digest.

content.title: Reject a relative edit from an outdated content digest
